name: ⭐ Don't Wake The Animatronics! ⭐
desc:
Shh... Don't Wake the FNAF! 🤫

Sneak around and steal animatronics while they sleep! 😴
Escape when you wake them up and they start chasing! 🏃‍♂️
Survive and collect as many animatronics as possible! ⚡
Earn money while you're offline!  💵

If you're having fun, remember to hit the thumbs up! 👍
